name: Scroll Highlight Text
description: A GSAP ScrollTrigger text reveal: the words of a paragraph light up one by one as it scrolls through the viewport, scrubbed to the scroll, and dim again on the way back.

props.name: dim
props.description: Opacity of the words not reached yet.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur in px on the words not reached yet. 0 keeps them sharp (and is cheaper).

props.name: start
props.description: Where the read-through starts, as a ScrollTrigger start.

props.name: end
props.description: Where every word is lit, as a ScrollTrigger end.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, if the text sits inside its own scroll container.
